This property is ideally available with a 10 month lease term - please inquire with your requested term* Step into a world of comfort and style in this beautifully furnished 1,100-square-foot condo, ideally situated in the vibrant city of Vancouver. This two-bedroom, two-bathroom residence offers a perfect blend of modern design and practicality, catering to those who appreciate a sophisticated urban lifestyle. The spacious layout provides ample room for relaxation and entertainment, with tastefully appointed furnishings that enhance the condo's contemporary appeal. Large windows allow for abundant natural light, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere in every room.

Beautiful 3-Bedroom Home in the Heart of Kitsilano Welcome to this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom home located at 2878 W 8th Avenue, Vancouver, in one of the city’s most sought-after neighbourhoods. This bright and inviting home features an updated kitchen, modern flooring throughout, spacious living areas, and an open, functional layout designed for comfortable everyday living. Large windows fill the home with natural light, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Outside, enjoy the convenience of a gated property, a single detached garage, and additional storage space. 2 patios and beautiful mountain view.

Description
Situated on a sun-drenched, south-facing corner lot in Kitsilano, this 1,700 sq. ft. Craftsman character home blends 1920s architecture with contemporary luxury and North Shore mountain views. The open-concept 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom layout features rich wood flooring, refined millwork, and a chef’s kitchen equipped with premium Wolf gas appliances and a Sub-Zero refrigerator. Step outside to a private, sunny yard and patio. Unbeatable Westside location: steps to General Gordon Elementary, Kitsilano Secondary, and the Kitsilano Bike Path for an easy ride to UBC or Downtown. Enjoy West 4th Avenue’s boutique shops, cafes, and dining, with Kits Beach and its saltwater pool just a short stroll away. If viewing on Zillow please text/email the leasing agent.

Description
Experience refined West Coast living in this custom Brandes luxury home, tucked in Point Grey’s coveted North of 4th. A reverse floor plan maximizes water views from the open-concept main floor featuring 11'+ vaulted ceilings. A private elevator connects all three levels, leading to a chef’s kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, custom millwork, a wine cellar, and a private theater. Relax on the rooftop deck with a hot tub and panoramic ocean, mountain, and city views. Finished with stone, marble, and full home automation, this 4-bed, 5-bath unfurnished residence blends warmth and modern luxury steps from Spanish Banks, Jericho Beach, UBC, and top schools like Lord Byng. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.
